Cuba at St. Vincent and the Grenadines

headlines.description: Bukayo Saka's stunner wrapped up England's 3-0 comprehensive win against Wales as Thomas Tuchel's side built on last month's impressive victory in Serbia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saka nets stunner as England ease to Wales win

headlines.description: Estêvão and Rodrygo both scored braces as Brazil cruised to a 5-0 friendly win over South Korea.
headlines.shortLinkText: Estêvão, Rodrygo star as Brazil hammer Korea

headlines.description: Teen sensation Nestory Irankunda has scored his second goal in two matches, while goalkeeper Paul Izzo starred to deliver the Socceroos a fiery 1-0 win over Canada.
headlines.shortLinkText: In-form Irankunda steers Socceroos past Canada

headlines.description: The United States battled back for a 1-1 draw with Ecuador after Folarin Balogun scored in the second half of a back-and-forth match at Q2 Stadium in Austin, Texas, on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Balogun strikes as USMNT rallies for Ecuador draw

headlines.description: Japan completed a stunning second-half turnaround to secure a first-ever victory over Brazil in Wednesday's friendly in Tokyo.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brazil stunned by Japan fightback in friendly

headlines.description: Lionel Messi had two assists and helped start a play that led to another goal, as reigning World Cup champion Argentina beat Puerto Rico 6-0 in a relocated international friendly on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Messi sets up 2 as Argentina trounce Puerto Rico

headlines.description: Haji Wright scored in the 33rd and 51st minutes off passes from Cristian Roldan, and the United States rallied to beat Australia 2-1 on Tuesday to end the Socceroos' 12-game unbeaten streak on a night Christian Pulisic left the game because of an injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wright stars in first U.S. comeback under Poch
